blocks.text: After you have created access policies and set up an AppProtection profile, you can create dynamic rules to automatically create AppProtection policies to inspect the traffic of your domains.
To add a dynamic rule to an AppProtection profile:

blocks.item: Go to Private Access > Private App Protection > App Protection Policy.

blocks.text: The Add AppProtection Dynamic Rule window appears.

blocks.item: In the Add AppProtection Dynamic Rule window, enter the following information:

On the Select Policies tab, in the General Information section, select access policies that you want to add a dynamic rule to. Access policies enabled with privileged approvals do not appear as they are bypassed by dynamic rules.
On the Profile Details tab, in the Selected Access Policies section, the access policies that you selected in the previous step are listed.
In the AppProtection Profile section, select the AppProtection Profile Type:
Default: If you select this option and a default AppProtection profile already exists, an error appears.
Existing: If you select this option, you must select an existing AppProtection profile from the drop-down menu.
On the Create Policies tab, in the Profile and Policies section, the AppProtection profile and the access policies you selected in the previous steps are listed.
To automatically create AppProtection policies, select the Auto create AppProtection policies checkbox.
On the Review tab, review the dynamic rule configuration, then click Done.
